blocks.text: Round-The-Clock Accessibility:
blocks.html: Round-The-Clock Accessibility:

blocks.text: The best thing about websites is that they are accessible all the time. Your customers can access your business’ website from anywhere at any time, whenever they want. Most customers across the world demand availability, and you have to be available at any time. If your business is not available to your customers, it can have a destructive impact on your business as well as take your customer away. So, web development for your business is essential to cater to your customer all the time.
